mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing temperatures around 74 degrees with overcast skies near City Hall and a moderate air quality index of 51. While the moon is currently in a Waxing Gibbous phase, there are no visible sightings of the International Space Station tonight.

The City of Verona is hosting an I Voted sticker contest for students in grades K-12 to design the official sticker for the November election. Designs must be original, and students have until July 22 at 4 PM to submit their artwork through the city website or in person at City Hall.

There is plenty to do this week in Verona. You can enjoy live music today at Bailey's Run Vineyard or the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, join a class at Insight Wellness for yoga, and keep an eye out for trivia nights starting on Monday at Hop Haus and the Wisconsin Brewing Company.
In a notable incident from July 13, Verona Police responded to a report of a vehicle stuck on a large rock, which resulted in the driver being arrested for a first offense O-W-I.
Today is the perfect day to grab the OREO Cookie Overload flavor of the day. The store is currently closed, but they will be ready to serve you starting at 10 AM.
